ownership: United States federal government public data
allowed_use: offline admission of explicitly authorized caller-supplied ACS 5-year files
derived aggregate datasets with source vintage, table, variable, estimate, and margin-of-error provenance
redistribution with Census attribution and disclosed ACS sampling limitations
prohibited_use: network acquisition without a separately approved acquisition plan
representing ACS estimates as exact counts
inventing percentages, estimates, margins of error, or values for missing cells
representing ZCTAs as USPS ZIP delivery boundaries
combining ancestry, race, Hispanic origin, sex, or age into an undocumented lineage construct
attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates.
retention: Retain admitted source files and immutable derived releases with their authorization declaration and checksums.
redistribution: Allowed for aggregate public Census data with provenance, vintage, ACS estimate/MOE labels, and limitations.
